(1) a component's interface definition should be augmented with interaction protocol specifications to ensure compatible interactions between components, and (2) such specifications can be validated by monitoring the actual interactions at runtime, and that this validation process can be integrated into a CORBA system.

the following issues: 1) How to specify interaction protocols in the IDL context. 2) How to validate component interactions with respect to such protocols. 3) How to use the protocol validation to test the correctness of component interactions.
